conviction_note: Trevi is the target of Webuild's mandatory, unconditional all-cash OPA at EUR 5.165 (acceptance period to 20 Nov 2026, Webuild already at ~39.9%), and the stock is pinned to it (spot 5.155, under 0.2% below the bid). A voluntary Q3 orders/backlog update cannot move a stock with a bank-guaranteed cash floor and no live competing bid (ICOP ruled out raising its offer on 5 Nov). So abs_move is the arb tape's own daily noise (~0.3%) and p_up sits just under 50 because the option value of a further bump is leaking away as the deadline nears. The single finding (-0.05) and the scaled number (-0.03) agree in sign and size.

findings.finding: Trevi trades as a cash merger-arbitrage on Webuild's mandatory, unconditional OPA at EUR 5.165 (conditions lapsed on 30 Oct, bank-guaranteed by Intesa Sanpaolo, Goldman Sachs and Natixis, acceptance period to 20 Nov 17:30), and ICOP has ruled out raising its competing offer. The stock (5.155 close on 10 and 11 Nov, after trading at 5.18-5.20 in mid-October on hopes of a further bump) is pinned within ~0.2% of the bid, the bump premium has gone, and the Q3 orders release cannot move it outside that band.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the 5.165 raise (5 Oct) the daily closes sat between 5.125 and 5.20 (Yahoo tape); on 5 Nov, the day of ICOP's no-raise statement, it fell 5.17 to 5.15 (-0.4%), the largest recent daily move.
findings.original_quote: Tutte le condizioni di efficacia si intendono decadute (all the conditions of effectiveness are deemed to have lapsed); l'OPA non è soggetta a condizioni di efficacia, con prezzo minimo di 5,165 euro per azione (the OPA is not subject to conditions, with a minimum price of EUR 5.165 per share). ICOP, 5 Nov 2026: non intende rilanciare né aumentare il corrispettivo (does not intend to bid again or raise the consideration).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: that is the finding. The tape already shows it: realised 20-day vol is 3.65% annualised against 18.8% over 60 days, and the mid-October premium over the bid has been removed. This finding sets the size of the move (tiny), not its direction. Its small negative lean is the leftover bump option decaying toward a deadline with no rival bidder.
findings.independence: The ICOP no-raise statement is a separate document from a separate party (https://www.teleborsa.it/DettaglioNews/45_2026-11-05_TLB/ICOP-nessun-rilancio-su-Trevi-Prosegue-con-il-piano-al-2029.html), and Webuild's market purchases are capped at 5.165 (https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/teleborsa/finanza/webuild-sale-al-399-di-trevi-dopo-nuovi-acquisti-sul-mercato-301_2026-11-05_TLB.html?lang=it).

outside_window.finding: Close of the Webuild OPA and ICOP OPS acceptance periods (20 Nov 17:30). Depending on Webuild's final stake (90%/95% sell-out or squeeze-out, or a residual float with no bid), the post-offer price could detach from 5.165.
ICOP extraordinary shareholders' meeting on the capital increase serving the OPS (13 Nov); it does not change the consideration

baseline_tension: Agrees with the flat run-up (-0.77% over 20 days, -0.19% over 5) and the near-zero priced lean. The +12% 60-day run-up is the offer being raised, not information.
language_note: The whole bid structure came from Italian sources (Teleborsa, Borsa Italiana news, Forbes Italia): the 5.165 raise, the 30 Oct mandatory-offer conversion with conditions lapsed ('Tutte le condizioni di efficacia si intendono decadute'), Webuild's stake path to 39.9%, and ICOP's 5 Nov no-raise. English coverage (Il Sole 24 Ore English edition, Marketscreener) stopped at the original 4.50 bid.
The financial-calendar line placing the 12 Nov board meeting on voluntary 30 Sep information ('informazioni periodiche volontarie... al 30 settembre') came from the Italian-language filing record.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: the file's 'in a live bid, results are noise; the offer is the finding' rule matches the draft, and its 'size the move larger' rules do not apply to a stock pinned under an unconditional cash bid
